title: Commission the repaired engine and complete break-in follow-up
completeness: Illustrated maintenance companion; not a stand-alone all-joint access or internal fit diagnostic. Actual required inspections and repairs must be recorded before completion.
entry_state: Exact standard US 2024 stock YZ450F engine repaired, refitted and assembled with accepted timing, cold clearances, oil supply/levels, coolant fill, controls and stationary checks; engine completely cool.

Correctly fitting Mityvac MV4560 cooling-system adapter and secure hose connections confirmed before this illustrated tester-method route. This is not a claim that MV4560 is identical to the Yamaha-listed kit.
exit_state: Actual post-head-gasket cooling test, selected replacement-part break-in and all required follow-up work recorded; no unresolved inspection findings.
Fuel-tank internal cleaning, inaccessible repaired-part fit assessment and all-joint checks require actual qualified work where this companion does not provide the method.

applicability.included: Exact US 2024 standard stock YZ450F after completed engine repair with a new head gasket and new valves, piston, rings, camshaft, gears, cylinder or crankshaft.
excluded: Use of other pressure testers without their reviewed operating method

preflight: Have original illustrated manual and torque-check sheet available.
Arrange qualified assessment for required inaccessible checks or checks outside operator capability.
Do not record work as completed unless physically performed.

required_tools.name: Mityvac MV4560 and verified correct cooling-system adapter; readable pressure gauge; thick cloth and eye protection
Secure stand; torque tools spanning 2.5–145 N·m for the actual joint-check sheet; timer; oil temperature measurement for the source level check
Clean drain container, filter tools, spoke wrench, cable lubricant applicator and chain measurement tool
Exact BHR diagrams and actual qualified tank-cleaning, repaired-part fit and all-joint inspection support

required_parts.name: Stock oil filter and new cover O-ring
required_parts.purpose: Deliberate filter renewal with post-break-in oil change

required_parts.name: New oil drain gaskets and filler O-ring
Foam filter oil, approved filter cleaner, lithium-soap and silicone greases
New exact pump gasket if pump removed

critical_stop_conditions: Oil debris, flow failure, leaks or abnormal running
Unresolved fit assessment or required inaccessible check
Generator looseness/contact damage or control fault

source.review_note: Independently reviewed against exact BHR and Mityvac tool-method pages; approved as the stated illustrated companion with actual external-work obligations.

steps.title: Accept the completed repair
steps.instruction: Record the exact repaired parts and completed engine-refit record. Accept cold clearances, timing, oil flow/levels, coolant fill, idle and controls before riding. The engine must now be fully cool. Any unresolved noise, leak or lubrication fault requires repair first. This companion does not itself perform engine removal/refit.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Choose the actual parts route
steps.instruction: New valves, piston, rings, camshaft or gears require about 30 minutes at no more than half throttle. A new cylinder or crankshaft requires about one hour: 20 minutes at no more than half throttle, inspect, then 40 minutes at no more than three-quarter throttle and inspect again. With both groups renewed, keep at or below half throttle for the first 30 minutes; this overlap is an explicit conservative workflow adaptation. Record the actual parts route.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Open filter access
steps.instruction: Release the sub-seat quick fastener. Press the intake-duct side inward, release both cover ribs, lift its rear and slide rearward out of the front projection. Release the retaining band and move the bracket in the arrow direction shown in the diagram. Withdraw filter/guide together and separate the filter, guide and seal. Leave the bracket mounted.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Clean and oil the foam
steps.instruction: Wash with air-filter cleaner or kerosene, squeeze without twisting and dry fully. Replace damaged foam. Work Yamaha or quality foam-filter oil evenly through the foam in a bag; wipe excess with a clean cloth. It must be wet throughout but not dripping. Do not use gasoline or the source-prohibited volatile cleaners.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Restore the sealed intake
steps.instruction: Fit seal/filter to the guide and grease the entire seal lips with lithium-soap grease. Move the bracket rearward, engage the guide projection with it and secure the other projection in the band. Engage cover projection and both ribs. Restore the breather through guide/groove, protected end in steering shaft and other end on cap. Secure sub-seat with tether untwisted.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Perform the pre-ride inspection
steps.instruction: Complete the pre-ride inspection: coolant/fuel/oil levels and no leaks; sequential shifts and smooth clutch; effective brakes; full throttle return and 3–6 mm free play; aligned lubricated chain; wheels/spokes/tires; smooth steering without play; smooth leak-free suspension; unrestricted cables and secure connectors. Cold tire pressure is 100 kPa (15 psi) front/rear. Correct failures before riding.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Attach the pressure tester while cold
steps.instruction: Use the Mityvac MV 4560 method only with confirmed correct radiator adapter fit. With the engine fully cool, remove the cap under a thick cloth, slowly vent at the detent, then remove after hissing stops. Fill coolant to the source upper level and inspect hoses. Wet the adapter seal with water or coolant, seat it in the filler neck and secure both hose compression connections. Keep the original cap off until testing and full cooling are finished.
verification: Record the actual equipment, condition and test result; unresolved faults remain pending.
steps.origin: Combined original companion: Yamaha BHR exact pressure/time; Mityvac Form801625 pages8–9 tool operation, not OEM adapter equivalence.

steps.title: Warm with the gauge connected
steps.instruction: Monitor the connected gauge while warming for Yamaha’s three minutes. Stop for rapid pressure rise, abnormal gauge behavior, leaks or pressure approaching the 137.3 kPa ceiling. Do not pump above that ceiling. If stopped for a fault, let the system cool fully before releasing pressure or disconnecting; investigate before repeating. This sequence combines Mityvac cold attachment/engine-on monitoring with Yamaha’s head-gasket warm-up requirement.
verification: Record the actual equipment, condition and test result; unresolved faults remain pending.
steps.origin: Combined original companion: Yamaha BHR exact pressure/time; Mityvac Form801625 pages8–9 tool operation, not OEM adapter equivalence.

steps.title: Check cooling-system pressure
steps.instruction: After the three-minute warm-up, stop the engine and apply only enough pressure to reach 137.3 kPa (19.9 psi), never exceed it. Confirm it holds for 5–10 seconds. Check radiator/hose joints for leakage and hoses for bulging. A loss of pressure or visible defect requires correction and repeat testing; record actual pressure and hold time.
verification: Record the actual equipment, condition and test result; unresolved faults remain pending.
steps.origin: Combined original companion: Yamaha BHR exact pressure/time; Mityvac Form801625 pages8–9 tool operation, not OEM adapter equivalence.

steps.title: Cool fully before removing the tester
steps.instruction: Leave the connected equipment undisturbed until the engine is completely cool. Then use the MV 4560 relief lever to release remaining pressure before disconnecting under a cloth. Refill to the source level and refit the radiator cap. This cold-release restriction comes from Mityvac page 9; never remove a hot cap or hot pressurized adapter.
verification: Record the actual equipment, condition and test result; unresolved faults remain pending.
steps.origin: Combined original companion: Yamaha BHR exact pressure/time; Mityvac Form801625 pages8–9 tool operation, not OEM adapter equivalence.

steps.title: Ride the first interval
steps.instruction: Warm the fully assembled engine using its accepted starting procedure. In a controlled off-road area, ride about 20 minutes at no more than half throttle. Stop immediately for a problem and record actual riding time/symptoms. Automatic stop after 7 minutes idling does not make idling into riding time.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Stop and inspect
steps.instruction: Check mounted areas for looseness and oil or other leaks. Resolve any problem before continuing. Record actual findings; a symptom-free interval does not complete post-break-in maintenance.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Complete the recorded parts route
steps.instruction: For valves/piston/rings/camshaft/gears without cylinder or crankshaft replacement, ride about 10 further minutes at no more than half throttle. For a new cylinder or crankshaft, ride about 40 further minutes; with new valves/piston/rings/camshaft/gears too, retain half throttle for the first 10 minutes, then never exceed three-quarter throttle. Stop for abnormal behavior and record actual time and throttle ceiling.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Inspect before maintenance
steps.instruction: Stop and thoroughly inspect mounted areas and leakage, cable stretch, brake action/free play, chain stretch and loose spokes. The riding period is complete only for the recorded parts route; maintenance below remains unfinished.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Drain and inspect the used oil
steps.instruction: Upright on level ground, warm the engine several minutes and stop. Place a clean container under both drains. Remove filler cap/O-ring and crankcase/oil-tank drain bolts with gaskets; drain both compartments completely. Inspect for dirt and foreign material, especially metal chips. If present, stop: Yamaha requires crankcase disassembly/inspection, not merely fresh oil and a passed record.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Renew the oil filter
steps.instruction: Renew the oil filter during this oil change. Remove the cover and old filter. Apply lithium-soap-based grease to the new cover O-ring, install it, and fit the exact new filter in the diagram orientation. Refit the cover bolts at 10 N·m. Filter renewal is included in this route; the post-break-in list itself requires the oil change.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Expose the generator mounting check
steps.instruction: With oil drained, remove sub-seat/seat, filter-case cover and left shroud. Label/disconnect stator and crank-position couplers. Remove the shift pedal, preserving punch-mark alignment, and retain both clamp-1 pieces and the single clamp-2 holder. Keep the engine installed during this inspection.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Open the left cover only
steps.instruction: Release cover fasteners progressively and lift the cover without pulling wires. Retain both dowels and holders/clamps; discard the gasket. Keep stator/grommet attached to the cover and rotor attached to the shaft. Secure assemblies do not need removal merely for a mounting inspection.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Inspect generator mounting
steps.instruction: Check generator rotor and stator mounted areas for looseness and visible contact damage, and inspect connectors. Keep sound mounted assemblies intact. Record the actual inspection. Loose or damaged assemblies require separate generator repair with correct taper/key, sealing and fastening steps; a blind torque check does not replace that repair.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Reseal the left side
steps.instruction: Fit both dowels and a new cover gasket. Restore cover/holders/clamps and tighten bolts in stages and crisscross to 10 Nm. Keep the undisturbed grommet sealed and wires unpinched. Align pedal/shaft punch marks, tighten the pedal bolt to 12 N·m, reconnect both couplers and restore the illustrated lead routing.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Close drains and refill
steps.instruction: Fit new drain gaskets: oil-tank bolt 10 N·m, crankcase bolt 20 N·m. Fill 0.96 L for this filter-removal service and apply lithium-soap-based grease to the new filler-cap O-ring before fitting the cap. Use Yamalube or an oil meeting API SG or higher and JASO MA; the listed SAE grades are 10W-40, 10W-50, 15W-40, 20W-40 or 20W-50. Do not add additives or use the source-prohibited CD-or-higher or ENERGY CONSERVING II oils. The settled window level is the final check. The 1.20 L disassembled capacity is not this service refill.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Inspect the repaired engine
steps.instruction: Check head/cylinder and crankcase/cover joints for pressure/oil leaks and cooling-system leakage. Check silencer body/stay for cracks/leaks and engine mounts for loosening. Record the actual repaired-part fit and contact inspection with the repair specialist where needed. Accepted old dimensions alone are not a fresh inspection of inaccessible surfaces; any suspect fit must be resolved before completion.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Inspect chassis and wheels
steps.instruction: Check frame, swingarm, linkage and bracket welds/mounts for cracks/looseness; wheels for damage/runout and bearing play. A tilted tire valve indicates tire movement requiring correction. Check fork/shock smooth operation, leaks and mounts. Raise front wheel, rock lower fork legs to check steering play and turn both ways; binding/play needs separate steering service.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Check spokes progressively
steps.instruction: Compare spoke tones by tapping: loose spokes sound dull. Replace bent/damaged spokes through the separate wheel repair. Tighten sound loose nipples progressively to 2.5 N·m, never a half-turn or more per adjustment. Continue staged checks until initial looseness disappears; record unresolved wheel faults.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Set chain alignment and slack
steps.instruction: With the rear wheel raised and transmission neutral, pull up the chain about 50 N above the guide mounting bolt and measure the illustrated guide-to-chain gap: 50–60 mm. To adjust, loosen axle nut and both locknuts; adjust sides equally and push wheel forward to seat both end plates. Tighten axle 135 N·m and locknuts 21 N·m, then recheck alignment/slack. Lubricate the chain. A stiff, damaged or worn chain requires separate cleaning/removal or replacement and clip closure; do not hide that work behind this inspection.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Inspect and lubricate controls
steps.instruction: Check both brakes for effective action without drag and the front-lever end for no free play. With reservoirs horizontal, fluid must be above the minimum marks in the diagram. Leaks or spongy action require separate brake service. Check cable-clutch free play at 7.0–12.0 mm: turn the handlebar adjuster; if insufficient, slide the cable cover, loosen its locknut, adjust at the cable, tighten that locknut to 4.3 N·m and restore the cover. Check smooth clutch action and unrestricted cable travel through full steering. Replace damaged cables; lubricate rough sound cables with engine oil or suitable cable lubricant at the upright cable end. Use silicone grease at brake-lever moving contacts and lithium-soap grease at clutch-lever and pedal pivots.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Record the required tank-interior service
steps.instruction: The post-break-in list requires cleaning inside the fuel tank and checking for leaks. Record actual qualified cleaning, not merely an appointment or fuel-color inspection. The cleaning method remains an external dependency. Follow exact tank access/refit: extract fuel with a pump; remove seat, side covers and shrouds; cover residual-pressure fittings with cloth, release holder/cover and both connector buttons by hand, protect disconnected joints and support the tank off its pump face. If pump removed, renew gasket lip upward, align pump projection with bracket slot and tighten the five bolts in the numbered order to 7 N·m. Restore tank front bolts 8 N·m and retaining screw 4 N·m, reconnect fuel hose until it clicks, restore connector cover and correctly oriented holder, and connect pump coupler. Record restored sealing and leak checks. Route the fuel hose and pump lead through the guide on the cover.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Restore access panels
steps.instruction: Restore both shrouds with each radiator-guard projection engaged in its shroud hole; tighten shroud fasteners to 7 N·m. Refit the left side cover and its 7 N·m fasteners. Slide the right cover into its projection/slot engagement, keeping its rib below the rear-fender rib; fit its 7 N·m fasteners and shared seat fixing at 13 N·m as illustrated. Restore filter-cover projections/ribs and breather routing. Refit the seat with its bolts at 13 N·m and secure the sub-seat with untwisted tether. Confirm all connectors, wire clearance, fuel connections and oil closures before restart.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Complete every applicable torque check
steps.instruction: Complete the post-break-in fastener checks using the linked joint table and its preparation conditions: frame/engine/seat, steering, suspension/linkage/pivot, wheels/spokes/sprocket, brake/clutch fasteners, fuel pump, shift pedal and bodywork. Record each joint or link the actual inspection sheet. Inaccessible/unidentified joints remain pending. Do not substitute generic torques or open hydraulic unions merely to create a check. Lower steering-ring preload requires its separate staged service. No completion with unresolved required checks.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Check flow at idle
steps.instruction: Start fully assembled engine at idle only and watch oil window for flow and decreasing level. Stop immediately if level does not decrease; diagnose lubrication before proceeding. Do not rev it to force a successful check.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Verify settled oil level
steps.instruction: Warm the oil to the specified normal 60°C (source says ten minutes; automatic idle stop may interrupt), stop, stand upright/level, run ten seconds, stop and wait a few minutes. Level must lie between lower window edge and maximum mark. Correct with specified oil, then warm several minutes, stop, settle and recheck. Record actual level/leaks; do not claim an unmeasured temperature was measured.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.

steps.title: Record actual maintenance completion
steps.instruction: After the engine is fully cool, check coolant at the illustrated maximum and confirm no continuing loss. Open a radiator cap only cold, using a thick cloth and slow release to the detent; wait for hissing to stop before pressing/turning it off, and secure it after checking. Repeat the pre-operation checklist. Complete only with actual pressure-test, riding, oil/debris, generator, repaired-part fit, tank-cleaning, chassis and all-joint records accepted. Missing required work remains pending.
verification: Record actual outcome; unresolved required work prevents completion.
steps.origin: Original companion wording checked against exact 2024 BHR pages; prior 2026 structure is not applicability evidence.
